decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - Before the relevant part of the development is commenced, details of the external materials, including roofing and flashing, shall be submitted to and approved by the local planning authority,drawings to be at a scale of not less than 1:10. The scheme shall be completed in accordance with the approved details.
Condition : 3 - The works to construct the development shall comprise the minimum alterations to the fabric of the building necessary for appropriate construction and completion of the works.
Condition : 4 - Where an opening is made in a wall the downstand lontol/beam and relationship with the load bearing nib walls shall be fully visible in the final result.
description: Demolition of conservatory and erection of a single storey rear extension plus internal alterations.
